we define a manifestly regular, conformally invariant object, the ratio of two regular polygonal Wilson loops, and we compute it at one and two loops in the weak coupling regime, and at one and two loop in the strong coupling regime.

the duality between scattering amplitudes and Wilson loops in the planar limit of $ \mathcal {N}=4$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory.
